firstPlayerRule: The player wearing the most green starts and receives the first player marker.
clarifications: The Growing phase proceeds clockwise from the first player.
After each season’s Kodama phase, the marker goes to the player with the lowest score; if tied, it goes to the tied player closest to the left of the current first player.
